name: Bloomflower Trials
desc: A competition to obtain Sacred Flame Crystals that was held in Natlan several centuries ago.

customize.name: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
customize.desc: A tournament in Natlan and one of Natlan's rules, created by Ruler of Death, Ronova. It is used to elect the Pyro Archon.

customize.text:
The Bloomflower Trials were competitions to obtain Sacred Flame Crystals. The Pilgrimage produced enough Sacred Flame, and the Bloomflower Trials became unnecessary.
Antu
The last Bloomflower Trials were held several centuries ago to heal the Qucusaurus Antu with Sacred Flame Crystals. The competition devolved into a massacre as the tribes sought to acquire the Crystals, and the Trials were no longer held.
Milray
Several centuries later, the Tepetlisaurus Milray fell ill with the same disease as Antu, so it was decided to hold new Bloomflower Trials.
Sacred Flame Crystals
Crystals that appeared during conflicts and were used to treat phlogiston-related illnesses. Some believed that crystals could make warriors stronger.
